known_source_metadata_caveats: Some source MIPAV XML files declare Unknown subject-axis orientation; the converted NIfTI affine supplied for that image was used and preserved.
For OAS1 rotated raw volumes, XML says Little endian but big-endian decoding exactly matches the supplied NIfTI voxel values.
Analyze headers provide no trustworthy physical origin; their voxel values match after orientation, but source-to-world placement cannot be proven.

The original hashes of NIfTIs already in the spectre source folder were not captured before in-place RAS normalization; source payload hashes and pre-normalization affines/orientations remain recorded where available.
